name: Fine-tuning imGHUM Pose and Shape
definition: A technique to improve the fit of the imGHUM model during training by optimizing time-consistent shape corrections and per-frame pose corrections, rather than keeping the initial imGHUM fit parameters fixed.
summary: Fine-tuning imGHUM Pose and Shape optimizes time-consistent shape and per-frame pose corrections during H-NeRF training to improve geometric fit, unlike methods using fixed priors.
